description: The census of the open classes after entry 142: for each of the 256 open classes (132 of (2,1,1), 124 of (3,1,1)) the entry-140 records (every endpoint of every finite component on every live frame) give the smallest genus of an endpoint each frame can reach for ALL its components; a class's best frame is the one minimising that.  Genus 0 (rational curves) and positive-rank elliptic or rank >= 2 genus-2 endpoints cannot kill; genus 3-5 hyperelliptic endpoints could, with 2-descent rank bounds and Chabauty-Coleman (a licensed Magma); no endpoint at all leaves the theory path.  The 64 classes reaching genus 3 or 4 are covered by FIVE hyperelliptic curves (R1-R5 of compute/qc/magma_tower143.m); R3 and R5 are even in x and split further.

higher_genus.targets: the classes whose best frame reaches degree 7-10 (genus 3 or 4): 40 of (2,1,1) at degree 8, 24 of (3,1,1) at degree 10
higher_genus.extraction: compute/symmetry_tower.analyse(want_all=True) on every finite component of the best frame, endpoint cores kept up to degree 12 (scratch copy symmetry_tower_hg.py: the threshold at line 538 raised from 6 to 12); normal form = primitive, square content removed, reciprocal merged

even_quotient.pari: ellfromeqn -> conductor 33424, ellrank [3, 3], no torsion: rank 3, useless
